item_short_desc: Rothco’s Neck Strap Key Rings are 32” long polyester lanyard that features a breakaway end strap and key ring. The neck strap also features a quick release buckle to disconnect the smaller strap from the lanyard for easy access to the attached key. The Neck Strap with Key Ring is perfect for keys, badges, ID card, whistles and more.
